_comment: Starting-point allowlist for Claude Code, verified against the settings format in use on 2026-08-31. This template will age as Claude Code changes; you own verifying and maintaining it. Copy it to .claude/settings.local.json, adapt paths and command families to your project, and keep that local file out of version control. The agentmarshal entries list only read-only subcommands; commands that write the journal or the local state, run extension code or delete branches (open, amend, submit-review, review, accept, agree, acknowledge, record-*, finding, complete, abandon, reopen, migrate-journal, init, outbox, step, stage, extension, prune --delete) stay with the operator — see docs/harness-setup.md.
